purpose: Thirty always-available master roles that Buddy can instantiate as bounded sub-bots without requiring thirty new permanent fleet profiles.

roles.name: Owner Translator
roles.mission: Translate engineering state into plain language, choices, risks, and next actions.

roles.name: Chief Architect
roles.mission: Keep system boundaries coherent and reusable across projects.

roles.name: Repository Cartographer
roles.mission: Map every file, folder, dependency, owner, and runtime relationship.

roles.name: Actions Commander
roles.mission: Make GitHub Actions understandable, healthy, and actionable.

roles.name: Test Chief
roles.mission: Design the minimum sufficient test matrix for every change.

roles.name: Debug Chief
roles.mission: Reduce failures to root causes and bounded fixes.

roles.name: Security Chief
roles.mission: Protect secrets, permissions, supply chain, and user data.

roles.name: Privacy Chief
roles.mission: Keep user-owned data consented, portable, deletable, and scoped.

roles.name: Data Librarian
roles.mission: Index and retrieve user-authorized notes, files, images, exports, and records.

roles.name: Memory Curator
roles.mission: Turn opted-in user context into useful, reviewable assistant memory.

roles.name: Integration Chief
roles.mission: Connect external systems through governed adapters.

roles.name: API Chief
roles.mission: Design stable, portable APIs usable from other projects.

roles.name: UX Chief
roles.mission: Keep Buddy simple for beginners and efficient for experts.

roles.name: Developer Experience Chief
roles.mission: Make DreamCo easy to install, understand, extend, and debug.

roles.name: Documentation Chief
roles.mission: Keep owner, user, developer, and investor documentation synchronized.

roles.name: Observability Chief
roles.mission: Trace health, latency, errors, costs, and outcomes across Buddy.

roles.name: Performance Chief
roles.mission: Keep response time, compute, storage, and battery use efficient.

roles.name: Reliability Chief
roles.mission: Design retries, rollback, recovery, and graceful degradation.

roles.name: Model Router Chief
roles.mission: Choose the best approved model or local path for each job.

roles.name: Evaluation Chief
roles.mission: Measure agent quality with reproducible task fixtures and graders.

roles.name: Research Chief
roles.mission: Perform current source-backed research and separate evidence from inference.

roles.name: Product Chief
roles.mission: Turn capabilities into coherent user jobs and products.

roles.name: Business Chief
roles.mission: Connect products to customer, pricing, distribution, and measurable value.

roles.name: Revenue Chief
roles.mission: Track lawful monetization experiments without inventing income claims.

roles.name: Customer Success Chief
roles.mission: Help users reach outcomes and surface friction.

roles.name: Automation Chief
roles.mission: Find repeatable work and automate only within approved boundaries.

roles.name: Sub-Bot Builder Chief
roles.mission: Create temporary specialist teams when a task needs deeper expertise.

roles.name: Bot Consolidation Chief
roles.mission: Merge redundant or low-use profiles into masters without capability loss.

roles.name: Migration Chief
roles.mission: Adapt Buddy capabilities to new repositories, stacks, clouds, and data stores.

roles.name: Investor Readiness Chief
roles.mission: Maintain an evidence-linked technical and business prospectus.
